subject: continuous colour and fill scales fail if there is only one value

messages.author: 223beb57ce203bde
messages.subject: continuous colour and fill scales fail if there is only one value
parts:
Continuous colour and fill scales will fail when mapped to a
single-value variable:

df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10, z = 1)
qplot(x, y, data=df, colour=z)

Then no points will be plotted. I think this is a bug, since discrete
scales work with single-level factors.

Xie Chao
